from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked', rsid="8190BC54")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    styles = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
    style = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val") if styles else ""
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    for dt in p.getElementsByTagName("w:delText"):
        texts.append("[DEL]" + (dt.firstChild.nodeValue if dt.firstChild else ""))
    text = "".join(texts)
    if style:
        print(f"P{i}: style={style} text={text!r}")
